title: Rule: no-progress jobs show the sweep; GPU in status bar + queue, non-GPU in the queue panel
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1102 - No silent work: every job shows in the queue (umbrella) (consolidation sweep 2026-10-12). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-1102/plan.md. Amend the MPI-1100 rule section in .claude/rules/dos_and_donts.md (Fabio's permission, 2026-10-12): a job with no real progress number shows the indeterminate sweep (status bar: tool:indeterminate / StatusBar.progress.setIndeterminate, MPI-147; elsewhere: MpiProgressBar mpi-progress--loading). GPU work = generation queue + status bar; non-GPU work (downloads, uploads, CPU) = a queue panel row with a progress bar. Trigger: the 360 pano queue fix shipped with no progress at all and Fabio had to ask for the sweep separately.
